name: opencode-openrouter-eu
description: OpenCode plugin that restricts the OpenRouter model list to the models served from a single data region (Europe by default).
author: Ferdinando Santacroce <ferdinando.santacroce@gmail.com>

scripts.compile: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --format esm
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run compile
